messages:
rebecca: Hey team — trying to pull up the EU inference service overview + model-health panels for inference-shard-eu but getting a 403 from Grafana. anyone else hit this or know the shortlink? :thinking:

kai: I can see those panels. shortlink is https://grafana.internal/r/XYw3l/inference-eu-overview — you might not be in the eng-runtime-obsv group. what does the 403 look like?

rebecca: it shows "You do not have permission to view this dashboard (HTTP 403)" when I open the link from my laptop. on VPN right now. tried incognito too.

olivia: @rebecca try the accessctl flow: `accessctl request --resource grafana:dash:inference-eu` and put a note "view for incident triage". It usually auto-approves for eng-runtime members but might require approver if not in the group.

rebecca: ran that, got pending. approver is listed as @marcus. Marcus can you approve?

marcus: approved. I also checked the dashboard permissions and it is owned by ops-obsv team with viewer role granted to eng-runtime-obsv. If you keep getting 403 after approval let infra-bot reindex policies.

infra-bot: Policy update applied for principal rebecca@redwood.ai — grafana.viewer role granted. It may take up to 30s to propagate.

rebecca: still 403, tried hard refresh.

kai: can you paste the exact URL you open? sometimes the shortlink redirects to an org-specific UID and that can fail if cookies from old org are present.

rebecca: url is https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/inference-eu-overview?orgId=5

olivia: drop the orgId param and try: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/inference-eu-overview — if that works, we need to fix our shortlinks service to not append orgId for cross-org dashboards. That's a known quirk.

rebecca: sweet — that worked. seeing service tiles and model health rows. thanks! :tada: any chance we can get a pinned alias in the team sidebar? it would help for oncall.

marcus: can do. i'll pin the shortlink to eng-runtime sidebar and add a perm check step to the runbook. leaving a note to consider adding a read-only group for contractors too.

rebecca: one more quick Q — traces link from the tile goes to loki/tempo and I get an auth error there as well. same approach with accessctl?

olivia: yep, `accessctl request --resource loki:read --resource tempo:read` — mention which service (inference-shard-eu). If you need immediate access ping me and i'll add a temp policy.

kai: also filed a small infra ticket to strip orgId from generated shortlinks: INFRA-7643. cc @rebecca for updates.

rebecca: thanks all. tagging this for the postmortem runbook update :memo:
